Mahmoud Khalil sues Columbia University over alleged doxxing and harassment

Mahmoud Khalil has filed a doxxing lawsuit against Columbia University, alleging the institution failed to protect pro-Palestinian students. The lawsuit claims the university did not adequately address incidents of doxxing and harassment experienced by students supporting the Palestinian cause. Khalil's legal action seeks damages and injunctive relief, asserting that Columbia's inaction created a hostile environment. The specific details of the alleged doxxing and harassment, and the university's response, are central to the legal proceedings.
